describe.description: The creature is shown in a three-quarter side-front view standing on a pale ground. It has a low, stout, quadrupedal body with a broad, flat, pale pinkish-tan head at the front, four thick wrinkled fleshy limbs ending in clawed feet, and a long thick tapering tail extending to the rear left. The entire dorsal surface from the back of the neck over the arched back and onto the top of the tail is covered in dense, overlapping, rounded brown to gray-brown scales with lighter tan edges arranged in diagonal rows, while the head, throat, underbelly, sides, limbs and underside of the tail are smooth, pale, wrinkled flesh with subtle mottling. Six prominent feathery pinkish-red external gills project outward from the sides of the neck immediately behind the head, three per side, and the head bears large round dark eyes, small nostrils, and a slightly smiling mouth.
